typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblCatalystEcnTradeBlotter1a_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Inventory as string,
		{BBG Trade Number} as string,
		{Ticket Number} as string,
		Cusip as string,
		{Security Description} as string,
		{B S} as string,
		Amount as string,
		{Total Cash} as string,
		Counterparty as string,
		{Trade Date} as string,
		{Settle Date} as string,
		{Trade Status} as string,
		Trader as string,
		Salesperson as string,
		{Sales Credit} as string,
		{Entry Date} as string,
		{Entered By} as string,
		{Canceled Date} as string,
		{Trace MPID} as string,
		{Trace MPID Override} as string,
		Origin as string,
		{Trace Control Number} as string,
		{Trace Status String} as string,
		{Impact Trade Number} as string,
		{Msrb Code} as string,
		{Sales Credit Code} as string,
		{Default Sales Credit} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromECNCATBLOTTERcsv
fromECNCATBLOTTERcsv derive(rowCreateDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> addrowCreateDate
addrowCreateDate sink(input(
		Origin as string,
		Default_Sales_Credit as string,
		Trade_Status as string,
		Entered_By as string,
		Impact_Trade_Number as string,
		Entry_Date as string,
		Trace_Control_Number as string,
		Trace_MPID_Override as string,
		Canceled_Date as string,
		Sales_Credit as double,
		Sales_Credit_Code as string,
		rowCreateDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Counterparty as string,
		B_S as string,
		Security_Description as string,
		Settle_Date as string,
		Trace_Status_String as string,
		Trade_Date as string,
		Trader as string,
		Amount as double,
		Ticket_Number as string,
		Msrb_Code as string,
		Cusip as string,
		BBG_Trade_Number as string,
		Trace_MPID as string,
		Inventory as string,
		Salesperson as string,
		Total_Cash as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Origin,
		Default_Sales_Credit = {Default Sales Credit},
		Trade_Status = {Trade Status},
		Entered_By = {Entered By},
		Impact_Trade_Number = {Impact Trade Number},
		Entry_Date = {Entry Date},
		Trace_Control_Number = {Trace Control Number},
		Trace_MPID_Override = {Trace MPID Override},
		Canceled_Date = {Canceled Date},
		Sales_Credit = {Sales Credit},
		Sales_Credit_Code = {Sales Credit Code},
		rowCreateDate,
		Counterparty,
		B_S = {B S},
		Security_Description = {Security Description},
		Settle_Date = {Settle Date},
		Trace_Status_String = {Trace Status String},
		Trade_Date = {Trade Date},
		Trader,
		Amount,
		Ticket_Number = {Ticket Number},
		Msrb_Code = {Msrb Code},
		Cusip,
		BBG_Trade_Number = {BBG Trade Number},
		Trace_MPID = {Trace MPID},
		Inventory,
		Salesperson,
		Total_Cash = {Total Cash}),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblCatalystEcnTradeBlotter1a_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblCatalystEcnTradeBlotter1a
